name: 男士低泡温和洁面乳款
description: 低泡温和深层净透，洁后清爽舒适不紧绷的男士洁面乳套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF neutral grounds, powder blue #C9D8EC and icy pale blue #EAF1F8 panels, deep steel blue #4A6EA8 accent backdrops
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, gentle directional keys, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte powder-blue countertop and smooth seamless studio backdrop
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line circular outline icons with small amber accent fills
styleLock.presentationRules: stable upright tube hero scale, centered placement, product never covered by props
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh clean skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of powder blue #C9D8EC, icy pale blue #EAF1F8, deep steel blue #4A6EA8 and one warm amber accent #F08A3C on clean white neutral grounds; cool-neutral tone; bright soft studio lighting with gentle directional keys and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line circular icon style with small amber accents; clean high-end skincare photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright tube product scale and centered placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底主图
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, tube standing upright and centered, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front key with gentle fill, one soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level view with the tube standing upright and centered, full product visible. Bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front key with gentle fill, one soft contact shadow grounding the product. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace bands and no props. Commercial beauty e-commerce quality with crisp edges. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no gradient background, no cut-off edges, no floating product.

shots.intent: 用深蓝画框与绿叶氛围承接首屏，一秒传递清爽洁净主张
shots.camera: dramatic hero view from below with a gentle upward tilt, tube leaning diagonally across a thin white picture frame
shots.lighting: cool soft studio key from the upper left, one long soft shadow falling across the backdrop
shots.background: textured deep steel blue backdrop #4A6EA8 with a thin white picture frame outline
shots.props: thin white picture frame and two green leaves, not covering the product
shots.whitespace: generous negative space across the top 25% for headline and pill labels
shots.textZone: top band headline 「{selling_point_1}」 and three small pill labels 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Dramatic hero view from below with a gentle upward tilt, the tube leaning diagonally across a thin white picture frame. Cool soft studio key from the upper left casting one long soft shadow across the backdrop. Textured deep steel blue backdrop #4A6EA8 with the white frame outline and two green leaves as props, nothing covering the product. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame. Generous negative space across the top 25% carries a headline 「{selling_point_1}」 and three small pill labels 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」. Negative: no dense body text, no more than one claim, no invented efficacy or percentage claims, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product.

shots.intent: 放大一天下来油光、污垢残留与洁面前后的状态落差困扰
shots.camera: matched split-screen framing, both panels photographed straight-on
shots.lighting: left panel harsh flat light, right panel soft clean light
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen for {product}, two matched panels with identical camera and framing, both photographed straight-on. Left panel: an abstract close patch of tired skin look with a dull oil sheen and residue suggested under harsh flat light, no real face shown. Right panel: {product} resting in soft clean light conveying a fresh comfortable state. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Powder blue background #C9D8EC on both panels with soft top light. The product occupies 40-50% of its panel, no extra whitespace between panels. Negative: no real model face, no fabricated medical, acne or radiation claims, no before-after skin transformation, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用细线图标矩阵把温和清洁的核心卖点讲清楚
shots.camera: top-down 90-degree overhead view of a flat infographic card
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.background: clean white rounded card #FFFFFF centered on powder blue #C9D8EC
shots.props: six thin-line circular icons in two rows with small amber accent fills
shots.textZone: card headline 「{selling_point_2}」 and short labels 「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」「{callout_6}」 under the icon rows
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic card for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Top-down 90-degree overhead view of a rounded white card centered on the backdrop. Even high-key flat lighting with no dramatic shadow. Clean white card #FFFFFF on powder blue #C9D8EC, six thin-line circular icons arranged in two rows with small amber accents. Card headline 「{selling_point_2}」 at the top and short labels 「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」「{callout_6}」 under the icon rows, evenly spaced with no extra whitespace bands. The product sits small at the card top edge and the graphic fills 50-60% of the frame. Negative: no dense body text, no duplicated icon rows, no invented ingredient or efficacy claims, no tiny unreadable text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 代入晨间洁面的真实场景，让买家完成自我投射
shots.camera: eye-level three-quarter view with a candid handheld feel
shots.lighting: soft morning window light from the left, 5500K, gentle mist, soft contact shadow
shots.background: matte powder-blue bathroom counter #C9D8EC with light morning mist
shots.props: a folded towel and a small tray, not covering the product
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Eye-level three-quarter view with a candid handheld feel, the tube standing on a bathroom counter beside light morning mist. Soft morning window light from the left, 5500K, soft contact shadow. Matte powder blue counter #C9D8EC with a folded towel and a small tray as props, none covering the product. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame, no extra whitespace bands. Negative: no visible face, no hands covering the product, no garbled label text, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no cluttered scene.

shots.intent: 以细腻丰盈的泡沫质地证明清洁体验
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, tight zoom on the foam texture, shallow depth of field with foreground sharp
shots.lighting: soft side light skimming across the foam surface revealing fine dense bubbles
shots.background: deep steel blue backdrop #4A6EA8 behind a white foam mass
shots.whitespace: minimal, the detail is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the rich foam of {product}, tight zoom on the foam texture with shallow depth of field and the foreground sharp. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft side light skimming across the foam surface to reveal fine dense bubbles. Deep steel blue backdrop #4A6EA8 behind the white foam mass. The foam detail fills 55-60% of the frame, minimal leftover whitespace since the detail is the subject. Negative: no blurry subject, no plastic-looking bubbles, no duplicated bubble patterns, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用同机位双卡对比呈现洁面后的清爽状态差
shots.camera: two matched panels photographed straight-on with identical framing and lighting
shots.lighting: even soft studio light, identical on both sides, no dramatic shadow
shots.background: two white rounded cards #FFFFFF on powder blue #C9D8EC
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce before-and-after comparison for {product}, two matched white rounded cards on powder blue #C9D8EC with identical framing, camera and lighting on both sides. Left card: a flat swatch of dull tired skin look conveying the pre-cleanse state. Right card: the same swatch tone reading fresh and comfortable after cleansing, with {product} placed between the two cards. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even soft studio light, no dramatic shadow. Each card fills about 40-45% of the frame, no extra whitespace bands. Negative: no fabricated skin transformation, no microscopy or pore imagery, no invented test data, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用空白参数卡与空印章位预留信任信息位，降低购买疑虑
shots.camera: top-down 90-degree overhead flat-lay of the product beside a spec card
shots.props: a rounded spec card with blank label-value rows and one empty circular seal placeholder, all fields left blank
shots.whitespace: generous margin around the card reserved for post-composite text
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust and spec screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Top-down 90-degree overhead flat-lay, the tube beside a clean rounded spec card with blank label-value rows and one empty circular seal placeholder, all fields left blank for later compositing. Even high-key flat lighting. Pure white background #FFFFFF. Heading 「{callout_7}」 on the spec card. The product and card together occupy 45-55% of the frame with generous negative space around the card. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings, test data, capacity or ingredient percentages; no QR code, no membership or promotion badge, no store signage, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 深蓝品牌色收口，双支组合暗示囤货并引导行动
shots.camera: slight three-quarter group view with a second unit standing behind to suggest a set
shots.lighting: even soft studio light with soft contact shadows, slightly punchier accent light
shots.whitespace: negative space in the upper third reserved for headline and button
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce promo close for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Slight three-quarter group view with a second unit standing behind to suggest a set, both upright. Even soft studio light with soft contact shadows and a slightly punchier accent. Deep steel blue background #4A6EA8. The group occupies 55-60% of the frame with negative space in the upper third for a headline 「{selling_point_3}」 and one CTA button 「{callout_8}」. Negative: no invented discounts, countdowns or claims, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text beyond the headline and button.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：①靛蓝纹理背景上斜置软管洁面乳主视觉，白色画框与绿叶道具，顶部大标题与三枚胶囊标签（净透、温和、保湿类短语）；②白卡圆角信息图，六枚细线圆圈图标两行排布，图标标签在源图中整体重复了一排；③痛点章节两块蓝色占位图配橙色叉标，左右标签同为电子辐射类说法（源图自身重复），随后出现「致力解决男士面子问题」字样与编号卖点列表起始；④编号卖点 01-03（洁净去污、洁后舒适、揉搓起泡）与皮肤横截面示意引言；⑤皮肤示意图（毛囊、粉刺、丘疹、脓疱标签）与清洁补水前后双卡对比、产品参数占位表（表内文字本身为「产品名称」占位）；⑥参数表延续，角落含二维码与入会促销角标。品类判定：软管翻盖洁面乳+清洁起泡卖点，硬证据判为护肤个护/面部护理；图内「男士面子问题」文案表明为男士向洁面乳，leaf 定为男士温和洁面乳，与库内男士海盐控油件语义不同。已剥离：品牌字标、二维码、会员促销角标、原文案原句、电子辐射等不可证说法、皮肤示意图与前后对比的具体功效结论；成分含量、容量、认证、检测类信息一律改为占位符或空白 proof 位，产品一律以 {product} 占位。
